title: A bipartisan group of 24+ House lawmakers forms the AI Safety and Innovation Caucus, seeking to balance mitigating AI risks with maintaining US leadership in AI (Owen Dahlkamp/Politico)
summary: Owen Dahlkamp / Politico: A bipartisan group of 24+ House lawmakers forms the AI Safety and Innovation Caucus, seeking to balance mitigating AI risks with maintaining US leadership in AI — A bipartisan coalition of over two dozen House lawmakers is forming a new artificial intelligence caucus.
